title: SourceValidationRequest
description: Human-in-the-loop source validation for RAG answers

query_id.description: ID of the original search query

case_id.description: Case ID for case-specific canvas state

selected_chunk_ids.description: IDs of chunks selected by user as valid sources

rejected_chunk_ids.description: IDs of chunks explicitly rejected by user

user_notes.description: Optional user notes about source selection

pin_to_canvas.description: Whether to pin selected sources to case canvas
